Which axis shows time and which shows distance?

The x-axis is the horizontal line at the bottom and usually shows time. The y-axis is the vertical line going up and usually shows distance.
To plot a point on a distance-time graph, find the time on the x-axis and the matching distance on the y-axis, then mark where they meet.
